name: Four Seasons Naples Beach Club
insider_take: This Gulf Coast gem sits on one of Florida's most pristine stretches of sand, where loggerhead sea turtles nest and Naples' legendary sunsets paint the sky in brilliant oranges and pinks.
whats_special: The resort features the only beachfront golf course in Naples, designed by Tom Fazio, where you can play among mangroves and catch glimpses of dolphins in the Gulf. The property also boasts Naples' largest spa and sits just minutes from the upscale Third Street South shopping district, known for its boutique galleries and waterfront dining.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the beachfront Turtle Club during sea turtle nesting season (May-October) for a chance to witness these ancient mariners returning to shore under the guidance of resort naturalists.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature "Everglades Adventure" excursion through nearby Big Cypress National Preserve, where you can spot manatees, alligators, and over 200 bird species. End your day at the resort's beach bar with a craft cocktail while watching for the famous "green flash" at sunset.
pros: Direct private beach access with pristine white sand
Exceptional Four Seasons service and attention to detail
Multiple dining venues including beachfront restaurants
Championship golf course and full-service spa
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects upscale market positioning
